The unchanged legacy validator runs first. The narrow status wrapper recognizes only the exact selected receipt and checks original50-row prefix plus the bound new operation slots.

Fresh operation and two3-call COLD task slots bind new operation/run identifiers, current source/profile, prospective scenario source bytes, new task specifications and normal round grants. Historical rows, Root, Host and old native bindings provide no restored authority.

Historical operation/grant head validation derives each prefix with active=None; unchanged headers and attempts preserve those hashes. Current or before-begin round validation rereads fresh source/task identities; historical validation permits the deliberate final source revision without accepting stale live binding.
Partial receipt/ledger writes retain evidence and fail closed; there is no automatic retry. No reference/native/kernel, policy or model selector changes.
